newsitem.title: USA: TVA says it investigating Tenn. nuke outage.
newsitem.headline: TVA says it investigating Tenn. nuke outage.

text.p: TVA Nuclear is investigating the cause of an outage at its 1,170 megawatt Watts Bar nuclear power plant and will not have an estimated restart date until the investigation is complete, a spokesman said Thursday.
The plant, located in Spring City, Tenn., tripped off line on Wednesday after the main feedwater pumps automatically shut down, spokesman Tom Tohill said.
"(A restart date) won't be determined until after the investigation, which is expected to wrap up sometime this afternoon," Tohill said.
The spokesman said Watts Bar had been operating continuously without a problem for 97 days previous to the Wednesday shutdown.
